controlFlow.note: Edges preserve assembly-order fallthrough across source labels and only explicit B_SCR_OP_GOTO, B_SCR_OP_JUMP*, B_SCR_OP_CALL, B_SCR_OP_RETURN, and B_SCR_OP_END* transfers. A null jump/call target is an explicit dynamic transfer with no source-label operand. Return/end edges deliberately have no static target. No runtime guard, handler branch, call-return continuation, address, or operand type is inferred.
